Hymn 84: Faith of Our Fathers
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Henri F. Hemy
Lyricist/Text Author: Frederick W. Faber
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 84 titled "Faith of Our Fathers" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Henri F. Hemy and the lyrics were written by Frederick W. Faber.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
